About

Sasha Beauty Salon, with its unique bouquet of services, is one of the first salons in the Emirates to offer a complete “Salon Spa” experience in U. A. E. Established in 1994, Sasha employs some of the best hairstylists and beauticians in the country. Our mission is to enhance the beauty and style of every customer with the utmost efficiency while adhering to the highest standard of service at all levels of procedure. Our team of professionals is extremely abreast of the modern trends and constantly strives in bringing the freshest styles and ideas to our discerning customer base.

Sasha Beauty Salon Vida Hills - SHB pairs a broad beauty menu with services that can be enjoyed together: clients mention gelish mani-pedis alongside a hot stone foot massage. Blow-dries, eyebrow shaping, and full-body massage are also on the menu, with reviews noting curls that hold for days and firm massage work for aching muscles.
